component.name: Animeko
component.summary: Watch anime with danmaku, cloud sync and BitTorrent streaming

description.p: Animeko is a cross-platform anime tracking and streaming client. It browses anime metadata and community ratings from Bangumi and keeps your watch progress in sync with your Bangumi account.

Episodes can be played from aggregated online sources, from your own Jellyfin or Emby server, or streamed straight from the public BitTorrent network with a built-in libtorrent engine. BitTorrent playback downloads progressively and seeds back to the swarm while you watch.

Danmaku are aggregated from multiple providers, including dandanplay and Animeko's own public danmaku service, and can be filtered by keyword or cloud rules. Everything can also be cached locally for offline viewing.
